item.title: The Edge: Olympics to ban trans athletes in women's events - WCCB Charlotte
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C.- A major shakeup in Olympic sports! New rules will bar transgender women from competing in women’s events. The International Olympic Committee says starting in 2028, eligibility will be limited to biological females, verified through a one-time genetic test. Officials say the move protects fairness and safety in competition, but critics argue it could open the door to discrimination...
